name: Debian Bookworm with Miniforge
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl nano sudo cmake build-essential ninja-build clang-15 llvm-15-dev && curl -fsSL https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Miniforge3-Linux-x86_64.sh -o /tmp/miniforge.sh && bash /tmp/miniforge.sh -b -p /opt/conda && rm /tmp/miniforge.sh && ln -s /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh /etc/profile.d/conda.sh && echo '. /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'conda activate base' >> ~/.bashrc
